lines: You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Lubna eats.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Courgette chickpea rice bowl
dishes.title: Chickpeas, courgettes, peppers and rice
dishes.method: Reheat the two labelled table portions together until piping hot, then finish with parsley and lemon.
dishes.why: The trade-off is a vegan shared base for Lubna, with separate finishes for Roxane and Ivar rather than one richer shared pot.

dishes.name: Herby chickpea rice plate
dishes.title: Chickpeas, courgettes, peppers and rice with herbs
dishes.method: Reheat the labelled portion until piping hot. Put the courgettes and peppers on the plate first, then the chickpeas, then the rice, and finish with parsley and lemon.
dishes.why: It keeps lunch warm and comforting while giving Roxane a distinct herby finish from the shared batch.

dishes.name: Smoky lentil rice bowl
dishes.title: Lentils, courgettes, peppers and rice
dishes.method: Reheat the two labelled table portions until piping hot, then add coriander and lime.
dishes.why: A warm one-pot dinner makes the reheatable workday plan feel comforting, with courgette as the loud vegetable.

dishes.name: Lime lentil rice plate
dishes.title: Lentils, courgettes, peppers and rice with lime
dishes.method: Reheat the labelled portion until piping hot. Put the courgettes and peppers on the plate first, then the lentils, then the rice, and finish with coriander and lime.
dishes.why: This gives Roxane a fresh, citrusy version of the warm lentil dinner without another cooking session.

preparations.title: Chickpea courgette rice pot
preparations.method: Fry the onion, courgettes and peppers in the oil for 5 minutes. Stir in the tomatoes, chickpeas, rice, paprika and water, bring to a simmer, cover and cook until the rice is tender. Stir, then weigh the ready food into three labelled boxes.

preparations.title: Lentil courgette rice pot
preparations.method: Fry the onion, courgettes and peppers in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the lentils, tomatoes, rice, cumin and water, cover and simmer until the lentils and rice are tender. Stir well, then weigh the ready food into four labelled boxes.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Chop all onions, courgettes and peppers first. Start the chickpea rice pot, cover it and simmer while washing the lentils and measuring the second rice pot. Box the lunch pot as soon as it is ready, then cook and box the lentil pot, labelling every box for its member.
